name: Tenvow Product Review & Rating
author: Abdul Kadir

sections.installation:
1. Install Tenvow Product Review & Rating from Plugins → Add New, or upload the zip.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Edit any post → open the Tenvow Product Review box in the sidebar.
  4. Check Enable Product Review, fill Product Name and Editor’s Rating (required for the box and schema).
  5. Optionally add brand, price, currency, SKU, and availability.
  6. Publish or update — the rating box and schema appear automatically.
sections.faq:
Does this work on pages or custom post types?

Currently standard posts only.

What if I leave the rating or product name empty?

The review box and schema are not output until both Product Name and Rating are set and the review is enabled.

Does uninstalling remove my data?

By default, no. Go to Settings → Tenvow Product Review and check Delete data on uninstall if you want a clean removal.

Does it conflict with Rank Math or other SEO plugins?

No. It only outputs Product / Review / Offer schema and does not replace Organization, WebSite, or WebPage schema from other plugins.

Where can I get support?

Website: Tenvow
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Product review meta box (name, rating, brand, price, currency, SKU, availability).
  • On-page Editor’s Rating box with verdict labels.
  • Product + Review + Offer JSON-LD schema for Google rich results.
  • Settings page with delete-data-on-uninstall option.
sections.description: Product review & rating box with Editor’s Rating, verdict labels, and valid Product + Review schema for Google rich results. Tenvow Product Review & Rating is a lightweight WordPress plugin for product and ecommerce review sites. Add an Editor’s Rating (1–10), automatic verdict (Excellent, Very Good, Good…), and valid Product + Review JSON-LD schema so search engines can show rich product review snippets. Built by Tenvow for publishers who need clean on-page ratings and SEO-friendly structured data—without bloat. = Why use this plugin? = * Product review rating box on every post — simple, readable, conversion-friendly * Editor’s Rating out of 10 with automatic verdict labels * Valid Product + Review schema (JSON-LD) for Google, Bing, and AI search * Offer schema support (price, currency, availability) when you enter a price * SEO & AI Search optimized structured data using your post author, excerpt, and site name * Lightweight & fast — no external libraries, no tracking, no ads * Works alongside Rank Math and other SEO plugins without replacing Organization/WebSite schema = Free features = * Enable/disable review per post * Product name, rating (1–10), brand, price, currency, SKU, availability fields * On-page Editor’s Rating summary box with verdict * Automatic Product + Review + Offer schema markup in the page head * Settings page (Settings → Tenvow Product Review) with optional “delete data on uninstall” = Schema fields (Google-friendly) = * Product: name, image (featured image), description, brand, SKU * Offer: price, priceCurrency, availability, url (when price is set) * Review: author, publisher, datePublished, reviewBody, reviewRating (1–10) = Documentation = Website: Tenvow
